title: Per-agent secret vault — reference/rotation view (issue #417)
description: The frozen reference/rotation VIEW over Google Secret Manager for the per-agent secret vault primitive. Upstream paperclip.ing ships a secrets resource family scoped per company/agent; this view names a secret (its GSM path, the agent and scope it belongs to, when it was last rotated and which agent consumes it) and NEVER carries the value (GR-6). Secret Manager remains the store of record — `store` is a const, so a second secret store cannot be expressed without failing by name. See docs/PAPERCLIP-ING-INTEGRATION.md and ADR-0012.

store.description: The ONE store of record. Secret Manager (GSM) is the authority for every secret value; this view is a projection over it. A second store is refused because two stores means two answers to 'what is the credential' (ADR-0012).

secrets.description: The declared secrets, sorted by gsm_path so the projection is deterministic.

secret_view.description: One secret, NAMED not carried: a reference into the store of record plus its rotation state. There is no value-bearing property, and additionalProperties is false, so a value cannot be expressed.

gsm_path.description: The GSM path the value lives at — the secret's name in the store of record. Requiring the GSM shape is what keeps this a reference into GSM rather than an arbitrary string.

agent.description: The agent (vault owner) the secret belongs to — a name, never a value.

scope.description: The scope a caller must hold to read the secret. An unscoped read is refused.

store.description: The store of record for this secret; identical to the document's store by construction.

consumer.description: The agent that consumes the secret. Null (or empty) is an ORPHANED secret: it is reported, never silently kept.

last_rotated_at.description: When the secret was last rotated, as an ISO-8601 instant; null when no rotation is recorded, so a never-rotated secret is visible as such.

rotated.description: True when a rotation time is recorded. Derived from last_rotated_at so the two cannot disagree.

allowed_runtimes.description: OPTIONAL (issue #1273): the closed set of runtime ids permitted to read this secret. Consulted by `fleet/channel.py::validate` against a directive's `task.secret`; a runtime not on this list is refused as secret-not-allowed:<runtime>:<gsm_path>, by name, and NEVER by carrying the value (GR-6). Absent means declared-but-unchecked (backward compatible with catalog rows written before this issue).
